_readme: Generated by `npm run sync-i18n` / `npm run translate-i18n` — do not edit by hand. Per locale and key: { status: "needs_translation", en_hash } = English placeholder; { status: "translated", method: machine|human|legacy, reviewed, date, en_hash } = translation of the English with that hash (a different hash means the English changed and the key gets retranslated).
